source_text: Empirical challenges to the mutilation frame emerge from studies isolating procedure effects from stigma: a 2023 analysis of 638 Somali women (predominantly Type I/II) in the US revealed FGC status unrelated to gynecologic issues (16.6% prevalence) or distress (20%), but discrimination experiences correlated with 5-fold higher odds of mental health problems (OR=5.11). [15]
